description: This source file implements functions for converting Git object files between different hash algorithms, including converting commit, tree, and tag objects. It also includes an overall object conversion interface that handles different object types and their specific conversions.

methods.name: int repo_oid_to_algop(struct repository * repo,const struct object_id * src,const struct git_hash_algo * to,struct object_id * dest)
methods.description: Converts an object ID from its current hash algorithm to a target hash algorithm within the context of a repository.

methods.name: int decode_tree_entry_raw(struct object_id * oid,const char ** path,size_t * len,const struct git_hash_algo * algo,const char * buf,unsigned long size)
methods.description: Decodes a raw tree entry, extracting its object ID and path.

methods.name: int convert_tree_object(struct repository * repo,struct strbuf * out,const struct git_hash_algo * from,const struct git_hash_algo * to,const char * buffer,size_t size)
methods.description: Converts a tree object buffer from one hash algorithm to another by decoding each entry and mapping OIDs.

methods.name: int convert_tag_object(struct repository * repo,struct strbuf * out,const struct git_hash_algo * from,const struct git_hash_algo * to,const char * buffer,size_t size)
methods.description: Converts a tag object buffer, adjusting embedded object IDs and signatures for the target hash algorithm.

methods.name: int convert_commit_object(struct repository * repo,struct strbuf * out,const struct git_hash_algo * from,const struct git_hash_algo * to,const char * buffer,size_t size)
methods.description: Converts a commit object buffer, remapping referenced object IDs (tree, parent, mergetag) to the new hash algorithm.

methods.description: General interface to convert an object file of a specific type (commit, tree, tag) between hash algorithms.
